description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between Recent Sequence Ratio and Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio. The x-axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The y-axis on the left is labeled “Perplexity” and has a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis on the right is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10. 

The line representing “Perplexity” is orange with circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at approximately 4.63 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 0, decreases to a minimum of 4.28 at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 60, and then increases to 4.62 at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 100. The line representing “Full Cache PPL” is red with circular markers and a dashed line style. It starts at approximately 4.63 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 0 and remains relatively constant at around 4.63 until a Recent Sequence Ratio of 80, where it increases to 4.66 at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 100. The line representing “GPU Mem. Ratio” is blue with circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at approximately 42 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 0 and increases to 93 at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 100. The line representing “Full Cache GPU Mem.” is brown with circular markers and a dashed line style. It starts at approximately 63 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 0 and remains relatively constant at around 63 until a Recent Sequence Ratio of 80, where it increases to 66 at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 100.
